shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "ls -la && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat index.html && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '*.css' -g '"'!node_modules'"' /home/sandbox 2>/dev/null | head -60"
/bin/bash -lc "cat tsconfig.json && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | head && ls node_modules | rg 'playwright|puppeteer|lucide'"

/bin/bash -lc 'mkdir -p /tmp/orbit-libs && cd /tmp/orbit-libs && apt-get download libglib2.0-0 libnspr4 libnss3 libatk1.0-0 libatk-bridge2.0-0 libdbus-1-3 libcups2 libxkbcommon0 libasound2 libgbm1 libcairo2 libpango-1.0-0 libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libxfixes3 libxrandr2 libatspi2.0-0 libwayland-server0 libpixman-1-0 libxcb-render0 libxcb-shm0 libthai0 libdatrie1 libfribidi0 libharfbuzz0b libgraphite2-3 libavahi-client3 libavahi-common3'

/bin/bash -lc "cat >> src/styles.css <<'EOF'
.app-shell{font-family:'Golos Text',sans-serif;background:#f7f8fa;--g-font-family-sans:'Golos Text',sans-serif}
EOF
for package in /tmp/orbit-libs/*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x \""'$package" /tmp/orbit-libs/root; done
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/orbit-libs/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu ldd /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1248/chrome-linux-arm64/chrome | rg '"'not found'"
/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/orbit-libs && apt-get download libdrm2 libfontconfig1 libfreetype6 libpng16-16 libxrender1 libxi6 libbrotli1'

/bin/bash -lc 'for package in /tmp/orbit-libs/*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$package" /tmp/orbit-libs/root; done
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/orbit-libs/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/orbit-libs/root/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/orbit-browser/check.mjs'

/bin/bash -lc 'for package in /tmp/orbit-libs/*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$package" /tmp/orbit-libs/root; done
cat > /tmp/orbit-libs/fonts.conf <<'"'EOF'
<?xml version=\"1.0\"?><"'!DOCTYPE fontconfig SYSTEM "urn:fontconfig:fonts.dtd"><fontconfig><dir>/tmp/orbit-libs/root/usr/share/fonts</dir><cachedir>/tmp/orbit-libs/font-cache</cachedir></fontconfig>
EOF
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/orbit-libs/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/orbit-libs/root/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu FONTCONFIG_FILE=/tmp/orbit-libs/fonts.conf node /tmp/orbit-browser/check.mjs'
